headline: SoftBank Shares Slump 15% on Global AI Selloff and Missed Anthropic Stake
summary: Shares in SoftBank Group plunged 15% amid a widespread retreat in global artificial intelligence stocks and comments from Masayoshi Son expressing regret over not buying into Anthropic.
why: SoftBank is among the world's most aggressive technology and AI investors, making its equity valuation highly sensitive to tech market downturns and portfolio exposure decisions.

impacts.name: SoftBank Group Corp.
impacts.why: SoftBank shares dropped 15% during a broad tech rout and Son's remarks on Anthropic.
